## Summary

**PCMPccB** (Vector compare): Byte-by-byte vector compare.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `8 x b – a → condition → d` |
| Syntax | `PCMPEQB <vea>,b,d`<br>`PCMPHIB <vea>,b,d`<br>`PCMPGEB <vea>,b,d`<br>`PCMPGTB <vea>,b,d` |
| Short | Byte-by-byte vector compare. |
| Condition codes | not affected. Register d holds the outcome. False = 0. |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | B |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | b |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7–4 | `0010` |
| 2 | 3–1 | CC |
| 2 | 0 | `0` |

- CC:
- eq = 000 (ne)
- hi = 001 (ls) unsigned hs (lo) unsigned is not implemented
- ge = 110 (lt) signed see the next page in the original.
- gt = 111 (le) signed

### Example

```asm
    pcmpgtb	d0,d1,d2	; d2 = (d1>d0)
    bsel		d1,d2,e0	; if (d1 > d0) then replace e0 with d1
```

```text
vea d0: 01 05 03 04 FF 00 70 FF
b d1: 05 01 03 FF 04 70 80 02
Result of pcmpgtb d0,d1,d2:
d d2: FF 00 00 00 FF FF 00 FF
Result of bsel d2,d1,e0:
d e0: 05 .. .. .. 04 70 .. 02
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no PCMPccB. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T use PCMPHS/PCMPLO: unsigned higher-or-same is not implemented. Combine PCMPEQ and PCMPHI with POR (see PCMPccW).
